Question: Is there any offer on Mobile App renewal (renewal due in December or January)?
Answer: Yes. BUSY Mobile App Renewal Offer for customers whose Mobile App renewal is due in December 2026 or January 2027: renew early at ₹2,700 + GST instead of ₹3,600 + GST (25% off). The offer is valid only till 30 November 2026, so the customer should renew now to lock this price and avoid the access expiring.

Question: Will I get the MMT (MakeMyTrip) voucher if I renew the Mobile App through a partner instead of the company?
Answer: Yes. The MMT voucher offer applies to Mobile App renewals (1-year or 3-year) whether the customer renews directly with the company (BIPL) or through a partner. Customers who renew through a partner are also eligible.
